definition: Documented common direct or indirect club-equity investor, including minority stakes; accounting common-control disclosure accepted with club ownership corroboration. Named strategic corporate minority stakes count, including Granada plc through SMG. This is a confirmed-minimum source screen, not an exhaustive beneficial-owner census.
interval_convention: Start inclusive, exit exclusive; earliest/latest dates bracket source precision, not statistical confidence intervals. For Hearts/Liverpool these bound a documented overlap window from annual snapshots rather than a fully reconstructed legal ownership episode. Null exit means no terminating disposal identified through research_as_of, not a guarantee beyond the latest source.
